title.zh: 将奎松市Quezon Boulevard的菲律宾儿童医疗中心更名为菲律宾儿科医院与发展中心的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Philippine Children's Medical Center in Quezon Boulevard, Quezon City, To Philippine Pediatric Hospital and Development Center
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Philippine Children's Medical Center in Quezon Boulevard, Quezon City, To Philippine Pediatric Hospital and Development Center

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7403_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Philippine Children's Medical Center in Quezon Boulevard, Quezon City, is hereby changed to Philippine Pediatric Hospital and Development Center.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
